description: Graphite drawing of a canyon with one plateau in the foreground and one hill and two plateaus in the background. There are clouds on the horizon. Along the floor of the canyon are bumps that appear to be plants. This artwork is on the back of *Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)*, 1916–1917 (cat. no. 150).
title: Untitled (Palo Duro Canyon)
